memories.author: D04
memories.text:
- Benign positional vertigo
  - Status: New onset, brief spinning episodes on lying down, negative for hearing loss.
  - Plan: Start betahistine 16 mg twice daily; meclizine 25 mg as needed for acute vertigo. Advise vestibular exercises. Weight 68 kg, waist 84 cm (female cut‑off 80 cm – central obesity).
- Diet: Breakfast – low‑salt, whole grain; Lunch – steamed vegetables, lean protein; Dinner – light, early.
- Due: HbA1c 2025-07-05

memories.text:
betahistine 16 mg 1-0-1 after food
meclizine 25 mg 0-0-1 SOS after food

memories.author: front_desk
memories.text: Follow‑up appointment booked for 2025-07-10 at 10:00 am with Dr Karthik Hegde (D04).

memories.author: D04
memories.text:
- Benign positional vertigo
  - Status: Episodes reduced to 1‑2 per week, still triggered by rapid head movement.
  - Plan: Continue betahistine 16 mg BD; add meclizine 25 mg BD for next 2 weeks then taper to SOS. Reinforce Brandt‑Daroff exercises.
- Weight 67.5 kg, waist 83 cm (still >80 cm).
- Diet: Breakfast – oatmeal with fruit; Lunch – dal, brown rice, salad; Dinner – soup, chapati.
- Due: HbA1c 2025-10-10

memories.author: D04
memories.text: Dix‑Hallpike test: Positive for right posterior canal BPPV – torsional up‑beating nystagmus lasting <1 min.

memories.author: D04
memories.text: Pure‑tone audiometry (both ears): Hearing thresholds within normal limits (0‑25 dB HL) across 250‑8000 Hz; no conductive or sensorineural loss.

memories.author: lab
memories.text: HbA1c 5.8 % (reference 4.0‑5.6). Slightly elevated; indicative of prediabetes.

memories.author: D04
memories.text:
- Benign positional vertigo
  - Status: Vertigo free for 3 weeks; occasional mild imbalance.
  - Plan: Continue betahistine 16 mg BD; stop meclizine (use only SOS). Reinforce low‑salt diet, weight reduction goal 5 kg.
- Prediabetes (HbA1c 5.8%): Lifestyle modification – 150 min/week brisk walking, avoid refined sugars.
- Weight 66.8 kg, waist 81 cm (borderline).
- Diet: Breakfast – idli with sambar; Lunch – quinoa, vegetable curry; Dinner – grilled fish, steamed greens.
- Due: HbA1c 2026-01-01; Lipid panel 2026-04-01

memories.author: patient
memories.text: I’ve felt a bit dizzy when getting up quickly from bed over the past few days, especially after missing my betahistine dose yesterday. No vomiting.

memories.author: D04
memories.text:
- Benign positional vertigo
  - Status: Mild positional dizziness on waking, likely due to missed betahistine doses.
  - Plan: Reinforce betahistine 16 mg BD with alarm; continue meclizine SOS only. Check orthostatic BP.
- Prediabetes: HbA1c stable; encourage continued lifestyle.
- Weight 66.2 kg, waist 80 cm (at cut‑off).
- Diet: Breakfast – wheat dosa with chutney; Lunch – millet pulao, raita; Dinner – lentil soup, vegetables.
- Due: HbA1c 2026-04-20

meclizine 25 mg 0-0-1 SOS after food

memories.author: D04
memories.text: Refer to ENT for vestibular rehabilitation therapy due to persistent positional symptoms despite medical management.

memories.author: D04
memories.text: ENT report: Right posterior canal BPPV confirmed. Performed canalith repositioning (Epley) – patient symptom‑free post‑procedure. Advised home Brandt‑Daroff exercises twice daily for 2 weeks.

memories.author: D04
memories.text:
- Benign positional vertigo
  - Status: Asymptomatic since ENT maneuver; no vertigo episodes in past 6 weeks.
  - Plan: Continue betahistine 16 mg BD for another 3 months then review; meclizine SOS only.
- Prediabetes: HbA1c 5.7% (ref 4.0‑5.6).
- Weight 65.5 kg, waist 79 cm (now below female cut‑off).
- Diet: Breakfast – poha with peanuts; Lunch – brown rice, sambar, salad; Dinner – grilled chicken, steamed broccoli.
- Due: HbA1c 2026-07-10; Lipid panel 2027-04-10 (next year)

memories.author: lab
memories.text: Lipid profile: Total cholesterol 185 mg/dL (<200 desirable), HDL 48 mg/dL (>40 good), LDL 102 mg/dL (<100 near optimal), Triglycerides 120 mg/dL (<150 normal).

memories.author: front_desk
memories.text: Appointment changed: original slot 2026-07-20 09:00 am moved to 2026-07-15 11:30 am with Dr Karthik Hegde (D04) per patient request.

memories.author: D04
memories.text:
- Benign positional vertigo
  - Status: Remained vertigo‑free for 3 months after stopping betahistine (tapered off 2026-09-01). No recurrence.
  - Plan: Discontinue betahistine; keep meclizine SOS only for rare breakthrough. Lifestyle maintenance for prediabetes.
- Prediabetes: HbA1c 5.6% (upper limit normal).
- Weight 64.8 kg, waist 78 cm.
- Diet: Breakfast – multigrain toast with avocado; Lunch – chickpea salad, brown rice; Dinner – steamed fish, quinoa.
- Due: HbA1c 2027-01-10
